text:
ajay: Quick heads-up — planning to cut release/1.12 tomorrow 2026-03-18 08:00 PT. Can folks do a fast pass on open cherrypicks/backports? If you need backport, reply with PR link + target branch + short reason. Also bump version files and CHANGELOG entries please.

maria: I have a small perf tweak on main — PR #4321. Non-breaking, touches scheduler. Requesting backport to release/1.12.

ajay: thx @maria — can you add the backport label and a one-line rationale in the PR? release team will triage.

maria: done — added `backport/release-1.12` label and note: "fix scheduler race causing 5-10% perf regression".

sam: FYI I have a docs-only change (PR #4330) that doesn't need code backport but we should bump docs version. I'll open a patch to changelog.

ci-bot: running backport precheck...

ci-bot: precheck results: 2 conflicts expected (PR #4321), unit tests unaffected. Recommend manual cherry-pick and quick local compile.

lina: assign me for the manual cherry-pick if nobody else volunteers. I can do it tonight and submit a cherrypick PR against `release/1.12`.

ajay: great — @lina please follow the backport checklist: 1) cherry-pick with `-x`, 2) run full unit + integration smoke, 3) add changelog blurb linking original PR, 4) tag `eng-releases` for review. Example commands:```bash
git checkout -b backport/1.12-4321 release/1.12
git cherry-pick -x abcdef1234567890
# resolve conflicts, git add, git commit
git push origin backport/1.12-4321
```

lina: will do. ETA tonight 22:00 PT.

maria: thanks @lina — let me know if you hit merge conflicts, I can help resolve.

sam: one more ask: remind everyone to include changelog snippets in PR description under `CHANGELOG` heading; release engineer will copy to consolidated changelog.

release-bot: scheduled: branch create `release/1.12` at 2026-03-18T15:00:00Z. If you need earlier cut, reply here.

ajay: note — cut time is 08:00 PT / 15:00 UTC tomorrow. If any blockers surface, flag here by 06:00 PT so we can postpone.

lina: backport PR opened: #4335 -> release/1.12, includes commit reference and changelog. Marked `needs-review`.

ajay: awesome. I'll do final sweep tomorrow morning and then invoke release-bot to create the branch. Thanks all! :tada:
